candidates.rationale: Fresh AP national story with concrete employer, university, hiring, retention and visa-process consequences.
Fresh and important, but recent episodes have already carried several federal-media power stories; Microsoft action was more operationally useful today.
Fresh local housing update combining inventory, sales, price, rent and mortgage context; not covered in the prior seven scripts.
Material rate move with operational consequence for preapproval, lock, payment and refinance workflows; justified rate-led lending segment.
Fresh Sibos reporting adds workflow metrics to a previously announced BNP/Google partnership and changes the ledger evidence.
Primary-source frontier safety and access development with named critical-infrastructure partners and clear limitations.
Fresh policy update, but it mostly clarifies existing high-risk use requirements; the Cyber Mission had a stronger operational hook.

Routine but useful Central Ohio planning weather; not counted toward freshness requirement.

stories.new_fact: The Trump administration announced it was suspending Microsoft and several other firms from a labor program used for foreign workers applying for green cards.
stories.new_takeaway: The operating consequence is retention, sponsorship and project staffing uncertainty, not simply another temporary-visa dispute.
stories.why_now: AP reported the suspension announcement on October 8, 2026.
stories.previous_coverage: The prior seven episodes did not cover this visa or green-card labor-certification action.
stories.uncertainty: The affected firms' legal response, agency process and proposed fee rules remain unresolved.
stories.watch: Whether Microsoft or the other suspended firms challenge the action or change sponsorship practices before related fee rules become final.

stories.new_fact: Central Ohio inventory rose year over year in August while sales fell, the median sale price rose and rents also increased.
stories.new_takeaway: More listings create negotiating room but do not solve the monthly-payment problem when prices, rent and rates all remain elevated.
stories.why_now: Axios published the Central Ohio housing update on October 7, inside the 48-hour window for this episode.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent Columbus segments covered transit, early voting, crisis response and weather; this local housing affordability update was not previously covered.
stories.uncertainty: September data will show whether inventory gains are becoming real affordability relief or just a slower high-cost market.
stories.watch: Whether local September housing data shows inventory still rising without price relief.

stories.new_fact: Freddie Mac said the average 30-year fixed mortgage rose to 7.40 percent, the seventh weekly increase and the highest level in nearly three years.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational issue is preapproval, lock, payment and fall-through triage for active files, not a generic rate recap.
stories.why_now: Freddie Mac's weekly survey and AP's story were published October 8.
stories.previous_coverage: The previous week covered Fannie guide changes, UAD exceptions, Freddie OAuth delivery, income calculator updates and several rate contexts; this is a material new rate shock with specific pipeline consequences.
stories.uncertainty: Bond volatility and oil-driven inflation fears could either extend the rise or stabilize if Treasury yields retreat.
stories.watch: Whether next week's Freddie Mac survey and lender rate sheets confirm another repricing wave.

stories.new_fact: Sibos reporting described BNP Paribas CIB using an agent-led Securities Services trade-break workflow with triage, efficiency and adoption metrics.
stories.new_takeaway: The useful buyer question changes from model choice to whether a redesigned back-office workflow can prove defect, exception and audit outcomes.
stories.why_now: The Sibos report was published October 8 and added metrics not available in the September partnership announcement.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent bank-AI coverage included Plaid, Incognia, Barclays, Upstart, Feedzai and Mastercard; BNP's production workflow metrics were not covered.
stories.uncertainty: The evidence is trade reporting from executive remarks, not an independent audit or regulator-reviewed result.
stories.watch: Whether BNP Paribas or Google Cloud publishes defect-rate, client-impact, exception-cost or audit evidence for the trade-break agent.
stories.ledger_row_changed: BNP Paribas CIB / lanes 4 and 8 / added production row for agent-led trade-break processing; changed from broad announced partnership background to a specific workflow with reported metrics.

stories.new_fact: Anthropic launched its Cyber Mission, including the Critical Infrastructure Defense Program for operational technology and government systems, and named founding partners.
stories.new_takeaway: The frontier implication is that cyber capability is being packaged for trusted defenders, but critical-infrastructure use needs outcome proof and strict action boundaries.
stories.why_now: Anthropic published the Cyber Mission announcement on October 8.
stories.previous_coverage: October 7 covered Anthropic's Cyber Verification Program; this is a separate program aimed at critical-infrastructure defense and open-source scanning.
stories.uncertainty: No vulnerability-closure rate, incident-reduction rate, false-positive rate or independent operational outcome has been disclosed.
stories.watch: Whether Anthropic or a founding partner publishes vulnerability closure, patch acceptance, false-positive or incident-response results.
stories.frontier_bar: Safety and security finding plus access shift for frontier cyber capabilities applied to critical-infrastructure defense.

stories.new_fact: AP reported an unsettled Thursday in U.S. markets, with oil higher, technology shares weaker, and Treasury yields reversing from morning highs.
stories.new_takeaway: For lenders and local finance, the rate path matters more than index scorekeeping because long-duration borrowing costs remain elevated.
stories.why_now: AP published the market wrap overnight into October 9 after the October 8 U.S. trading session.
stories.previous_coverage: Markets have been covered compactly all week; this update is included only as current context for rates and financing conditions.
stories.uncertainty: It is unclear whether technology weakness stays narrow or spreads into broader credit-sensitive shares.
stories.watch: Whether technology weakness broadens while long yields remain elevated.

stories.new_fact: The Columbus forecast called for a mostly sunny Friday near 77 degrees, a Friday night low near 53, and another warm Saturday.
stories.new_takeaway: Outdoor work and evening plans are favored; the only practical issue is layering for cool starts and warm afternoons.
stories.why_now: The forecast applies to October 9 in Columbus.
stories.previous_coverage: Routine weather is updated daily and kept compact.
stories.uncertainty: Forecasts can shift; no advisory-level weather was identified at cutoff.
stories.watch: Whether the weekend cloud and temperature pattern changes.

editorial_review.notes: Compared facts and takeaways against the previous seven scripts. Repeated FCC/media items were omitted. Home lending leads with active-file repricing and fall-through workflow consequences. AI in Banking updates the ledger with BNP Paribas CIB trade-break metrics and labels evidence limits. Frontier AI separates Anthropic program design from measured outcomes. Closing has exactly three watch items.
